tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists the services offered by Brian Sudney (Gab-E Holdings, LLC) with prices, from the published facts file.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Returns the full published facts for one service, including its boundary line where it has one.

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Matches a stated need against the published services using the signal words in the facts file. Deterministic matching only; when nothing matches, it says so and returns the full list.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Returns the official door for a service: the payment link where the service has one, or the tagged site link and contact door where it does not. This endpoint routes only; it books nothing and takes no payment.
